title: cephalonoplos segetum
intro: Cephalonoplos segetum, commonly known as the "Sneezeweed," is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as colds and coughs, as well as reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of allergies. The therapeutic actions of Cephalonoplos segetum include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
